description: ONNX-runtime TTS with pluggable phonemizers (eSpeak, Gruut, Epitran) and a shared adapter framework for VITS and OptiSpeech voices. This fighter runs the Miro Swedish voice with the eSpeak phonemizer.
notes: Voice from the OpenVoiceOS phoonnx voice collection on HuggingFace (OpenVoiceOS/phoonnx_sv-SE_miro_espeak).
